info.title: GSM Supplier API: internal reference
info.description:
Every route of the API: admin console, merchant portal, storefront, REST API v1, Dhru Fusion, incoming webhooks and system routes. Generated from the route contracts; the public subset is `/openapi.json`.

Each operation shows its access kind (`x-gsm-access`), the permission a staff route, or the scope an API key, needs (`x-gsm-permission`) and the manifest key (`x-gsm-key`).

**Conventions.** JSON bodies use camelCase names. Money is a string with exactly four decimals (`"12.4900"`), timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds (`"2026-03-01T09:30:00.000Z"`) and ids are numbers. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`; quote the `requestId` when you contact support.

get.description: Checks Postgres (critical), the two Redis roles and object storage. Always answers 200 with `{ status, checks }`; with `?strict=1` it answers 503 and the same body when the status is `down` (a critical dependency failed), for load balancers and readiness probes. Contains no versions, hostnames or error texts.

get.description: The public OpenAPI 3.1 document: the REST API v1 operations, the Dhru Fusion reference operation and the webhook events we send. Generated from the route contracts and committed as `docs/contract/openapi.public.json`.

x-request-id.description: Id of this request; quote it when you report a problem.

apiKey.description: Merchant API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. A key has scopes (each operation names the one it needs), an optional list of allowed IP addresses and its own requests-per-minute limit.

capabilityToken.description: An unguessable token in the path (checkout, order tracking, support ticket or sign-in link) that authorises exactly one record. Sent by email or shown once; stored only as a hash.

customerSession.name: gsm_store_session
customerSession.description: Storefront customer session cookie, set by the sign-in routes under `/store/v1/auth` (password or sign-in link). HttpOnly; carries the `__Host-` prefix in production. Requests that change data also send `X-CSRF-Token`.

dhruCredentials.description: Dhru Fusion credentials are not an HTTP header: send `username` and `apiaccesskey` as form fields in the request body. The key must carry the `dhru` scope and passes the same IP and rate-limit checks as a REST v1 key.

gatewaySignature.description: Payment gateway webhook, verified per gateway with its signing secret. Deliveries outside a 5-minute window are refused and events are de-duplicated by the gateway event id.

merchantSession.name: gsm_client_session
merchantSession.description: Merchant portal session cookie, set by the sign-in routes under `/client/auth`. HttpOnly; carries the `__Host-` prefix in production. Requests that change data also send `X-CSRF-Token`.

metricsAccess.description: Prometheus scrape access: loopback and private networks, or `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>`. When a token is configured it is required from every caller.

staffSession.name: gsm_admin_session
staffSession.description: Staff session cookie, set by the sign-in steps under `/admin/auth` (password, then the 2FA code). HttpOnly; carries the `__Host-` prefix in production. Requests that change data also send the `X-CSRF-Token` header returned by sign-in. The permission a route needs is shown in `x-gsm-permission`.

urlSecret.description: A secret path segment (for example `/webhooks/telegram/{secret}`) that only the provider knows; a wrong secret answers as if the route did not exist.

webhookSignature.name: X-GSM-Signature
webhookSignature.description: Header we add to every outgoing webhook event: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>">`, keyed with the secret of the webhook endpoint. Recompute it over the raw body and refuse deliveries older than 5 minutes. Documented for receivers; it cannot be used to call this API.
